In the advertisement, there were training about how to drop-ship product from AMAZON to EBAY. Actually, i had to do research about hot selling products on amazon and try to find out some products which are selling on **Amazon** at very low cost in comparison to** eBay.** So i figure out some products where i can make a $1-$25 profit on each product, and then I listed the same product images on eBay from Amazon. And boom, i got many orders from Ebay, then i put all the shipping information of the customer from Ebay, and place the same order on Amazon with my customer’s shipping details and done. and I got my profit margin from Ebay, Now the twist came out… Finally, i put my mind on how to find good products which can be sold directly to eBay without using AMAZON Drop-shipping Strategy. As I don’t have anything to sell on **Amazon** so I went to my friend who was selling mobile accessories in his physical store.
